attribution: Aldieri, La Mattina, Szyszko, Baruffaldi, Viceconti (2025). HFValid collection. University of Bologna. DOI:10.6092/unibo/amsacta/8431
segmentation: Dataset author CT segmentation reviewed and corrected in Slicer 4.11; imported with its full CT into Slicer 5.12.4, saved as a segmentation and exported as a closed surface. No synthetic anatomy.
limitations: Original DICOM-derived CT is distributed by the authors as an NRRD volume.
This demonstration uses homogeneous material, not CT density-calibrated properties.
Distal fixation and head compression are illustrative boundary conditions, not a full musculoskeletal loading model.
This independently computed FEA does not reproduce the dataset authors' fracture-risk analyses.
No mesh-convergence study or clinical validation is claimed.

surface_preparation.method: Slicer closed surface; vtkDecimatePro 80% triangle reduction with topology preservation. Complete femur; no cut planes.

coordinate_system: RAS, mm, original CT geometry converted from LPS by Slicer
stress_association: Raw element stress retained in VTU and boundary cells; displayed contours use volume-weighted nodal averages of solved element von Mises stress
displacement_association: Solved nodal displacements, magnitude in surface VTP, vector in VTU
mesh_processing: TetGen boundary-conforming tetrahedra from the Slicer surface; switches -pYq1.4a80z. Boundary triangles preserved.
boundary_conditions: Clamp nodes within 15 mm of distal minimum Z; uniform -Z traction totaling 800 N on exterior triangles within 8 mm of maximum Z and within 25 mm of femoral head center
material: Homogeneous isotropic linear elasticity, E=10000 MPa, nu=0.3, uncalibrated
